document.abstract: This paper is the narration to a sound slide film introducing the Navy's new laboratory at Anacostia, D. C. (construction completed December, 1943). It gives a brief history of military photography leading to the Navy's need for its own laboratory for secret and confidential projects, discusses military organization, gives a tour of the laboratory, presenting especially the work of divisions concerned with motion picture production, still photography, aerial photography, graphic arts and photolithography, and sketches the services which the laboratory performs for all ships and stations.
